manaNeeded: {U} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery card
notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Flusterstorm by paying {U}, targeting the instant or sorcery.
Flusterstorm's storm ability triggers, creating a copy of Flusterstorm for each spell you've cast before it this turn, with each copy targeting the original Flusterstorm.
Resolve a copy of Flusterstorm, exiling Flusterstorm and allowing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat from step 3.
